name: Park City (United States)
description: Divided per fess and per pale into light blue and white, charged at the centre with two overlapping leaf shapes in green and teal bearing a white star.
history: Park City is a city in Sedgwick County, Kansas, United States and a northern suburb of Wichita. The flag was adopted on 16 February 2019 (designed with Gardner Design after community meetings and revealed at the Park City Administration Building on 16 February 2019, according to Flags of the World citing the Ark Valley News).

features.role: two overlapping leaf shapes in green and teal
